# Milestone 4 — Firebase: auth gate, onboarding, Firestore progress (plan, 2026-09-23)

## Context

School requirements still open after M3: a BaaS (Firebase, decided 2026-09-17) and
Cloud Firestore synchronisation of progress. Progress today is `InMemoryProgressRepository`
(lost on restart, streak stuck at 0). The handoff has an entry flow the app skips entirely:
screens 01 (accroche), 02 (connexion / inscription), 03 (niveau), 04 (objectif quotidien),
and a Profil tab (18) that is a placeholder.

Decisions taken in brainstorming (user, 2026-09-23):

- **Scope of this plan:** Firebase bootstrap + App Check, email/password **and Google**
  sign-in, gate at launch, **all four** onboarding screens, Firestore progress behind the
  existing `ProgressRepository`, Security Rules with emulator tests, **minimal** Profil
  (account, XP, sign-out). Not here: Isar (settings, scan history), full Profil 18
  (streak, activity graph, badges), Apple sign-in, `firebase_ai` (M5).
- **Gate at launch:** no user → onboarding 1 → login. No anonymous auth.
- **Folders (user's flat layout):** `lib/auth/` (repository, impl, providers, welcome +
  login screens), `lib/onboarding/` (level + goal screens), `lib/profile/` gains the
  profile model, repository, providers and the real screen; `lib/progress/` gains the
  Firestore repository next to the in-memory one; `lib/app/` router becomes a provider,
  `main.dart` boots Firebase.
- **Data shape:** two documents. `users/{uid}` = profile (`level`, `dailyGoalMinutes`,
  `createdAt`). `users/{uid}/progress/current` = progress (`completedLessonIds`, `xp`,
  `updatedAt`). One repository and one rules block per document. Onboarding writes the
  profile only; lessons write progress only.
- **Rules:** user writes `firestore.rules` with tutoring; Claude writes the emulator test
  harness under `firebase/rules-test/` (node, `@firebase/rules-unit-testing`). Claude needs
  the user's explicit OK to write under `firebase/` (not in the CLAUDE.md write list).
- Onboarding answers are profile data synced by Firestore, not device settings (Isar rule
  untouched: Isar keeps what never leaves the device).

Working mode unchanged: user writes `lib/`, Claude tutors and reviews; test-writer owns
`test/`; Claude owns docs and the rules test harness; Claude drives adb for device checks.

## Data flow

```
main: ensureInitialized → Firebase.initializeApp(DefaultFirebaseOptions) → FirebaseAppCheck.activate → runApp(ProviderScope(TenpaiApp))

authStateProvider   = StreamProvider<AuthUser?>(repo.authState())           // FirebaseAuth.authStateChanges mapped
profileRepositoryProvider = Provider<ProfileRepository>((ref) => FirestoreProfileRepository(db, uid))   // uid from authStateProvider; throws StateError if none (redirect guarantees a user)
userProfileProvider = AsyncNotifierProvider<UserProfileNotifier, UserProfile?>  // build: load(); complete(level, goal): save + state
progressRepositoryProvider (existing) → FirestoreProgressRepository(db, uid)   // replaces InMemory in the provider; InMemory stays for tests/fakes? no: delete it, FakeProgressRepository covers tests

routerProvider = Provider<GoRouter>: refreshListenable = notifier poked by ref.listen(authStateProvider) and ref.listen(userProfileProvider)
redirect(state):
  auth = ref.read(authStateProvider); profile = ref.read(userProfileProvider)
  auth loading                      → /splash            (logo tile, no spinner)
  auth null                         → allow /welcome, /login; else /welcome
  auth ok, profile loading/error    → /splash            (error: RetryWidget on splash, invalidates userProfileProvider)
  auth ok, profile null (new user)  → allow /onboarding/level, /onboarding/goal; else /onboarding/level
  auth ok, profile set              → block /splash, /welcome, /login, /onboarding/* → /apprendre; everything else allowed
```

Screens call the repository through `ref.read(authRepositoryProvider)` and catch
`AuthFailure` for inline copy; navigation never happens in the screen, the redirect does
it when the auth stream emits. Level travels to the goal screen in the query string
(`/onboarding/goal?level=seen`), per the "ids in the path, not `extra`" rule.

`FirestoreProgressRepository.completeLesson`: guard `isCompleted` on the loaded value, then
one `set(..., SetOptions(merge: true))` with `arrayUnion([id])`, `FieldValue.increment(xp)`,
`FieldValue.serverTimestamp()`; return the new value computed locally (no re-read, so
offline works). `load()`: `get()`; missing document → empty progress.

## Security Rules (user writes; shape to reach)

```
match /users/{uid} {
  allow read: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
  allow create, update: if owner
    && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['level','dailyGoalMinutes','createdAt'])
    && request.resource.data.level in ['never','seen','some']
    && request.resource.data.dailyGoalMinutes in [5,10,15,20]
    && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time (create) / == resource.data.createdAt (update);
  match /progress/current {
    allow read: if owner;
    allow create: if owner && data.completedLessonIds is list && data.completedLessonIds.size() <= 1
      && data.xp is int && data.xp >= 0 && data.xp <= 100 && data.updatedAt == request.time;
    allow update: if owner
      && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['completedLessonIds','xp','updatedAt'])
      && request.resource.data.completedLessonIds.hasAll(resource.data.completedLessonIds)
      && request.resource.data.completedLessonIds.size() == resource.data.completedLessonIds.size() + 1
      && request.resource.data.xp - resource.data.xp >= 1
      && request.resource.data.xp - resource.data.xp <= 100
      && request.resource.data.updatedAt == request.time;
  }
}
```

Threat model unchanged (ROADMAP 2026-09-18): the client is untrusted input, rules validate
shape and bounds, a user cheating their own progress has no victim.
